targets.title: Targets
targets.description: Remote MCP endpoints, OpenAPI URLs/spec paths, or Apify Actor IDs/URLs to audit. Add at least one target.

url.description: HTTP URL for MCP/OpenAPI or an Apify Actor URL.

actorId.description: Apify Actor ID or owner/name (used instead of URL when target type is apify-actor).

failOn.title: Fail run severity
failOn.description: Exit with a failed run when findings reach this severity.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum seconds to wait for each HTTP request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy configuration. Leave as false for direct connections.

exportFormats.title: Export formats
exportFormats.description: Reports to write to the Key-Value Store and attach to the run.

includePassingChecks.title: Include passing checks
includePassingChecks.description: Include successful checks in the dataset and SUMMARY report.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Validate targets and configuration without making network requests.
